text_block_list.text:
Early in the afternoon, North Flight, who 
had traveled abroad to visit her mother, 
shared stories from her trip.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—I learned all about Korean makeup and 
K-pop outfits straight from the source, 
and the tanghulu I bought on the way home 
was so yummy♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Here, a souvenir for you, Trainer. It's a 
pouch, but the silver horseshoe embroidery 
is quite stylish—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Flight-senpai! Hello~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's the thing you bought at the Korean 
shop earlier, right? So it was a souvenir 
for Trainer-san~

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly♪ It's a subtle design, so I 
thought adults could use it daily too.
choice_data_list: Did the two of you go together?
Did the two of you go together?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Gran-chan and I are travel buddies, 
after all! We had a bit of a connection 
before, so—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. When you think of Paris, this is the 
place to be. Ah, but I'm curious about 
this shop over here too, so let's add it 
to the route—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Paris? Flight-senpai, are you traveling 
abroad?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Mom's always flying around the world 
for work. Whenever I go visit her, I have 
fun sightseeing and shopping too~

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
! I want to go to that too! Can't I come 
along!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're more than welcome♪ Ah, 
make sure you get permission from your 
parents first, okay?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Where do you want to go, Gran-chan? Let's 
plan a route so we can hit as many of the 
places we both want to see as possible♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'll happily go wherever you want 
to go, Flight-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can rack up tons of miles for 
overseas trips, that's all that matters to 
me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, it's a generous offer, but it 
might be a little bit of a waste.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, why don't we look for a 
place we can enjoy together?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: We can enjoy it together...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even just one place is fine. I'll 
look for somewhere Gran-chan and I can 
enjoy together too!

text_block_list.name: Flight's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Paris, the City of Light! Make 
sure you two enjoy yourselves to the 
fullest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First up is a spot of my choosing— 
Gran-chan, Mom, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! A real milestone! To think I 
can touch a piece of mile racing 
history...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In the past, stones were placed at regular 
intervals as distance markers... They say 
that's how the mile became a unit of 
distance.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan loves the mile, so I thought a 
spot like this might be nice too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Totally! 160 miles of pure romance!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So this is a "place we can enjoy 
together."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Huh~. So this is the place Gran-chan 
picked!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
When I think of you, Flight-senpai, I 
think of fashion! And the shop had 'Mile' 
in its name, so I thought it looked nice!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The brand logo is super cool too— the 'M' 
for Mile! You can put together a whole 
matching Mile coordinate!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, how about we come up 
with mile outfits for me and Gran-chan 
together♪ Something so wonderful even Mom 
will be impressed!

text_block_list.name: Flight's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's already the day to go home... Time 
really flies. How did you like this 
overseas trip?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's 200 miles of pure fulfillment! It 
felt completely different from anything 
before!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Looking for places to go together and 
actually going there was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I want to do it again! ...Go on an 
overseas trip with Flight-senpai!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —...I see. Yeah, I'd love to♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Now, going on trips together with 
Gran-chan whenever we go visit Mama has 
become a regular thing.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! At first it was just for the miles, 
but now I truly enjoy traveling itself!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about racking up miles. 
There's excitement beyond the mile, too—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Flight-senpai, I finally 
realized it! You really are the ultimate 
mile racing veteran!
choice_data_list: Seems like you two have a good dynamic.
Looks like you two get along great.

mile...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Flight-senpai, I finally 
realized it! You really are the ultimate 
mile racing veteran!
choice_data_list: Seems like you two have a good dynamic.
Looks like you two get along great.

What does that have to do with the 
mile...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so♪ I'm so happy to have a 
travel companion too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Having the option to think, "If I go with 
Gran-chan," leads to new encounters at 
every destination—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Just like how combining items makes an 
outfit shine even brighter. Thanks to 
Gran-chan, I've come to love traveling 
even more♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Two milers coming together means an 
infinite amount of happy miles, doesn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Let's keep traveling to all 
sorts of places together♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I sure do! All 1,000 miles of it!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Flight-senpai shows me the world that 
expands beyond the mile... Both in races 
and everywhere else!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I've had a mile revolution in 
my head so many times now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're flattering me too much~.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If being around adds a little color to 
Gran-chan's life, then that's the greatest 
joy of being an upperclassman♪
